players.product: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) anti-PD-1 therapy; intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), jointly developed with Moderna

quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck Presents One-Year Results from the Pivotal Phase 2b/3 (10-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: One-year results of the pivotal Phase 2b/3 BRUNELLO trial (984 participants) of remigromig (MK-3000), a tri-specific Wnt-pathway agonist antibody, in diabetic macular edema, presented at AAO 2026: mean BCVA gains at Year 1 were +9.1 letters with remigromig 0.5 mg and +8.7 letters with 0.8 mg versus +11.8 letters with monthly 0.5mg ranibizumab, within the prespecified non-inferiority margin; no secondary endpoint showed superiority. Proliferative diabetic retinopathy adverse events were more frequent with remigromig (6.7% and 6.1% versus 0.9%), as were discontinuations for adverse events (4.9% and 4.5% versus 0.9%); additional analyses are underway. Results will be discussed with regulators; the pivotal Phase 2b/3 BAROLO study continues. Research president Dean Li: the first new mechanism of action in more than 20 years to show non-inferior visual acuity to anti-VEGF standard of care in a pivotal DME study.
